summary: A worker asks payroll to hold back more and still gets a much smaller refund than planned.
realLife: An Associated Press account entered in a 2019 House hearing record reported this case. The McCreanors increased withholding from her checks, but their income and tax rate also rose and the refund fell.
inGame: needs: a dated withholding change and comparable returns show a missed refund target.
gates: A dated withholding change and comparable returns show a missed refund target.

turns.what: The family checks how many paydays it covered.
turns.pulledBy: The preparer has the change date.
turns.writesBack: The next estimate uses the remaining pay periods.

turns.what: The preparer requests the payroll history.
